content.snl: def-hyp(list-partial(Type.judge(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.judge(@m, Real)), list-partial(Analysis.minPoint(F, m), Analysis.maxPoint(F, m)), Logic.forall-typed(@x, Real, Logic.implies(Set.mem(x, Analysis.domain(F)), $#0 \geqslant #1$(Type.apply(Analysis.map(F), x), Type.apply(Analysis.map(F), m)))))

values.en: `m` is a minimum point of `F` iff `F.map x ≥ F.map m` for every `x` in the domain; maximum points reverse the inequality. These are the points whose existence `BasicAnalysis.thm.extremeValue` asserts, and whose interior instances `BasicAnalysis.thm.fermat` constrains.
values.zh-CN: `m` 是 `F` 的最小值点，当且仅当`F.map x ≥ F.map m` 对定义域中每个 `x` 都成立；最大值点则将不等式反向。这些点的存在性由 `BasicAnalysis.thm.extremeValue` 断言，而其中位于内部的点受 `BasicAnalysis.thm.fermat` 约束。
